sources.title: A comprehensive survey on contrastive learning - ScienceDirect
sources.snippet: Abstract Contrastive Learning is self-supervised representation learning by training a model to differentiate between similar and dissimilar samples. It has been shown to be effective and has gained significant attention in various computer vision and natural language processing tasks.
